تعشوا (form I)
# تَعُشُّوا (taʕuššū) /ta.ʕuʃ.ʃuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of عَشَّ (ʕašša)
# تُعَشُّوا (tuʕaššū) /tu.ʕaʃ.ʃuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of عَشَّ (ʕašša)
